name: carrier
brief: The enemy carrier of the boarding mission: 60 m, two decks, robot-crewed. Built on its collision layout (layout.json): every walkable surface and doorway matches the boxes. Boarded through the hangar door at the stern, fought forward to the shield console on the bridge at the bow. Industrial, machine-scaled: ribs and conduits overhead, bulkhead frames at doors, hazard-marked hangar door with edge lights, a green-screened bridge. Outside: blue-grey armour on a gunmetal hull, oxide-red jaw and accents, warm running lights and engine glow. No turrets or button (the game draws them).
